mapper.sql: p.place_id, p.region_id, r.sido_name, r.gugun_name, p.source_type, p.source_id, p.title, p.address, p.latitude, p.longitude, p.description, p.heritage_type, p.period, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM historical_places p LEFT JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = p.region_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}
SELECT ht.tag_id, ht.tag_name, ht.tag_type FROM place_tags pt JOIN history_tags ht ON ht.tag_id = pt.tag_id WHERE pt.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY ht.tag_type, ht.tag_name
SELECT image_id, place_id, image_url, thumbnail_url, source_type, is_main AS main, created_at FROM place_images WHERE place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY is_main DESC, image_id

SELECT n.news_id, n.title, n.url, n.summary, n.source, n.published_at, n.created_at FROM place_news pn JOIN news n ON n.news_id = pn.news_id WHERE pn.place_id = #{placeId} ORDER BY n.published_at DESC, n.created_at DESC
